ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Model
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
function onload()
    color = self.held_by_color
    if color != nil then
        colorRGB = stringColorToRGB(color)
        self.setColorTint(colorRGB)
    end

    damageButtonparams = {
        click_function = "spawnDamage",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "Damage",
        position       = {0, 0.1, -0.45},
        rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
        width          = 150,
        height         = 50,
        font_size      = 30,
        color          = {1, 0, 0},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        tooltip        = "Click here to spawn a damage marker beneath the vehicle.",
    }
    self.createButton(damageButtonparams)
end

local tokenBagGUID = "bbc10d"

function spawnDamage()
    local bagObject = getObjectFromGUID(tokenBagGUID)
    local targetPos = self.getPosition()
    local sourceRot = self.getRotation()
    	local targetRot = {sourceRot["x"], sourceRot["y"] + 90, sourceRot["z"]}
	
    	self.setPositionSmooth({targetPos["x"], targetPos["y"] + 0.5, targetPos["z"]}, true, false)
	
    local newToken = bagObject.takeObject({position=targetPos, rotation=targetRot, smooth=false})

end
